mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_lessons (course_id, lesson_type, title, content, media_url, duration_minutes, exam_config_json, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{lessonType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{mediaUrl}, #{durationMinutes}, #{examConfigJson}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM training_lessons WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE training_lessons SET course_id = #{courseId}, lesson_type = #{lessonType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, media_url = #{mediaUrl}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, exam_config_json = #{examConfigJson}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE training_lessons SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE training_lessons SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
